instruction: From the book reading spreadsheet on the desktop, use https://howlongtoread.com/ to find the Science Fiction book with the highest word count. Record its title in book_list_result.docx.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully examined the book reading spreadsheet, visited howlongtoread.com to look up word counts for each book, calculated words per day, identified 'Out of the Silent Planet' as having the slowest reading pace, and wrote the title to book_list_result.docx.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open and read spreadsheets in LibreOffice Calc, navigate to external websites in Chrome, look up book information, perform calculations (words/day), open and type in LibreOffice Writer documents, save files.
metadata.task_rationale: Combines genre filtering with word count comparison. The agent must filter Science Fiction books (2001: A Space Odyssey, Out of the Silent Planet, The Andromeda Strain) and find the one with highest word count via howlongtoread.com. The Andromeda Strain has 97,773 words, the highest among Sci-Fi entries.
metadata.explanation: Custom getter reads the docx file from VM and extracts text. Metric checks if the text contains 'The Andromeda Strain' (the Science Fiction book with the highest word count at 97,773 words). Partial credit given for partial title matches.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads docx file from VM using env.controller.get_file() and extracts paragraph text via python-docx, returning {'text': text} format.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_title') without incorrect nesting through 'rules' key.
Case-insensitive substring check ('the andromeda strain' in text) is appropriate for verifying the title was recorded in the document.
Postconfig correctly saves the docx file (Ctrl+S) before the getter reads it, ensuring fresh state.
Partial credit logic (word overlap at 0.5x weight) is a reasonable fallback for partial matches.

Expected value 'The Andromeda Strain' is claimed to have 97,773 words - the highest among the Sci-Fi books in the spreadsheet. This is plausible but cannot be independently verified without access to howlongtoread.com data at task creation time.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The expected title correctness depends on howlongtoread.com data which may change over time. Consider adding a note about data freshness assumptions.

Minor: The activate_window postconfig uses strict=true with exact window name 'book_list_result.docx - LibreOffice Writer' - if the document was not opened in Writer by the agent, this could fail silently. However, the task requires writing to the docx, so it should be open.
